title: Monochrome Logo Family
slide_intent: Show how to preserve identifying features when reproduction is limited to one ink. Small optical changes can affect how clearly the mark reads.
strategic_value: CSAIL can keep its family of lockups recognizable in single-color materials by providing dedicated drawings.
demonstration: The four-tier family matrix reappears in black. A note specifies that the monochrome artwork includes optical adjustments.
practical_value: Select the monochrome master for the required organizational level and orientation.

content_islands.name: Optical adjustment note
content_islands.spec: Introduce the redrawn single-color artwork in the left rail. Place the artwork-selection reminder near the bottom.

content_islands.name: One-color matrix
content_islands.spec: Use the same primary, tag, secondary and tertiary rows as the color family. Show each supported variant in black.
